issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds
issues.issue: The governmental funds are modified cash basis, but basis is recorded as GAAP because the roll-forward is fund balance. Ponca_FY2025 has the same layout from the same auditor and was recorded as 'cash' with fund balances in the cash fields and proprietary null. The two reports are treated inconsistently.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents (69,774); Certificates of deposit 12,687; Restricted cash and cash equivalents 683,539; County treasurer cash 13,521; Total assets 639,973
issues.issue: ending_cash is only the overdrawn unrestricted cash line. The governmental funds also hold 709,747 of restricted cash, CDs and county treasurer cash, so all their cash totals 639,973 (= total assets). The figure follows the printed line, but it understates the cash held.

issues.extracted: only the p1 1-dollar imbalance is recorded
issues.on_page: Governmental funds balance sheet: Total assets 639,973 vs Total liabilities and fund balances 639,972 (General Fund column (451,869) vs (451,870))
issues.issue: The governmental funds balance sheet on p4 also prints a 1-dollar rounding difference, and it isn't in report_discrepancies. This page is not the balance_sheet source (p1 is), so it doesn't affect recorded figures.

The Statement of Activities (p2) counts this line in charges for services: Economic development 18,117 = 720 + 17,397. It is repayment of loan principal, so 'other' with review is defensible. Charges for services would match the report's own classification.

issues.on_page: Contributions and grants 254,935 (operating grants 190,387 + capital grants 64,548, pp2-3)
issues.issue: This mixes grants and contributions and the grantors aren't stated. Part (e.g. Economic Development 64,548, Recycling 15,761) may be government grants (state aid). Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Grant income 10,000 (Water, nonoperating); p3 Capital Grants and Contributions 10,000; p8 Grant proceeds under capital and related financing
issues.issue: This is a capital grant. It could go in business_type.other_financing (capital contributions), and the source (government vs private) isn't stated.

This is probably the Electric Fund's franchise payment to the city. It would make up most of General Fund 'Taxes: Franchise' 151,524 (Administrative 151,519). The same money appears as business-type spending and governmental revenue. That is acceptable as a quasi-external transaction, but it is internal.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 85,324 (Rescue Fund 48,483, Library Board 18,760, Youth Activity 18,081; p15-16)
issues.issue: Most of this line (57%) is Rescue Fund money, so 'ambulance/rescue fees' is the dominant category. The rules call for the dominant category plus a review note naming the mix.

issues.on_page: Cemetery 15,330 + Recycling 1,212 = General Fund Public works 16,542 (p5)
issues.issue: The rules list cemetery under health/welfare and recycling is refuse. The extractor used streets/highways so the split ties to the statement's Public works line, and that does tie. Judgment call, review already set on detail[132].

issues.on_page: Debt Service budget schedule prints only 'Interest income 3,308'; no Total resources line
issues.issue: No total is printed on this schedule. The detail_totals entry repeats the single line amount and isn't marked computed. The amount is correct.

[fixed 2026-10-21: review note added to combined salaries and benefits lines] These lines combine salaries and benefits but are recorded as salaries and wages with no review note. Ponca's identical lines carry review.
